strings.about.text:
OpenCADIrrigation — CAD don ƙirar ban ruwa ta matsi.
Injin ruwa: Hazen‑Williams / Darcy‑Weisbach, Global Gradient Algorithm (Todini‑Pilati), nazarin lateral mataki-mataki, auna bututu bisa gudu da tagar matsi tare da la'akari da tattalin arziki.
Yana gudana a mai binciken gizo, ba tare da shigarwa ba.

strings.welcome.title: Barka da zuwa OpenCADIrrigation
strings.welcome.body: CAD don ƙirar ban ruwa ta matsi, kai tsaye a mai binciken gizo. Fara da misali da aka shirya ko ɗauki koyarwa mai mu'amala: kusan gajerun matakai 50 inda kai da kanka ka ke kewayawa, zana, gina hanyar sadarwa da ƙirƙira; kowane mataki yana gane lokacin da ka kammala shi kuma ya ci gaba. Yana ɗaukar kusan minti 15 kuma ana iya tsallake shi kowane lokaci (Taimako → Koyarwa mai mu'amala yana sake buɗe shi).
strings.welcome.examplesHint: Kowane aiki yana buɗewa a shirye don ƙira: danna F5 ko ▶ ka ga yankuna, matsi, girman bututu da jerin kayan aiki. Fayil → Misalai yana sake buɗe kowanne daga cikinsu.

strings.exg.bananas.title: Gonar ayaba

strings.exg.gravity.title: Ɗigo ta nauyi
strings.exg.gravity.sub: Tafki m 40 sama da rukunin kayan lambu biyu masu ɗigo, ba tare da famfo ba: bawul na ƙofa, bawul na rage matsi da tace mai faifai a babban bututu; layukan tsayi na gangara.
strings.exg.pasture.title: Makiyaya da fesa ruwa
strings.exg.pasture.sub: Filaye uku na m 72 × 72 masu layukan masu fesa ruwa na bugu a m 12 × 18, manifolds da bawuloli, tafki, famfo da bawul na hana komawa.

tutorial.Moves on by itself when done (click to t: Yana ci gaba da kansa idan an gama (danna don kashewa)
tutorial.Auto-advance off (click to turn on): Ci gaba ta atomatik a kashe (danna don kunnawa)
tutorial.You can reopen this tutorial from Help →: Za ka iya sake buɗe wannan koyarwa daga Taimako → Koyarwa mai mu'amala. Ƙira mai daɗi!
tutorial.The mouse wheel zooms around the cursor;: Ƙafar linzami tana ƙara girma kewaye da siginan linzami; + da − ma. A waya, matse.
tutorial.Roll the mouse wheel over the drawing: Juya ƙafar linzami a kan zane
tutorial.Drag with the middle or right button, ho: Ja da maɓallin tsakiya ko na dama, riƙe Space ka ja, ko yi amfani da maɓallan kibiya.
tutorial.Pan by dragging with the right button: Motsa kallo ta hanyar ja da maɓallin dama
tutorial.Home (or the alias Z, or View → Zoom all: Home (ko gajeriyar Z, ko Kallo → Nuna duka) yana nuna duka ƙirar.
tutorial.With the Select tool (Esc returns to it): Da kayan aikin Zaɓi (Esc yana komawa gare shi), danna wani abu. Shift yana ƙarawa zaɓi.
tutorial.Click a valve (orange triangle) or a pip: Danna bawul (triangle mai launin lemu) ko bututu
tutorial.Drag left to right for fully enclosed ob: Ja daga hagu zuwa dama don abubuwan da ke cikin taga gaba ɗaya; dama zuwa hagu don duk abin da taga ta ƙetare.
tutorial.Drag a window over a block (3 objects or: Ja taga a kan rukuni (abubuwa 3 ko fiye)
tutorial.Drag a selected object to move it. With: Ja abin da aka zaɓa don motsa shi. Da abu ɗaya da aka zaɓa, maƙallai suna bayyana: ja kusurwa, ja maƙallin tsakiya don saka kusurwa, Ctrl + danna yana cire ɗaya.
tutorial.Ctrl+Z undoes (or the alias U), Ctrl+Y r: Ctrl+Z yana warwarewa (ko gajeriyar U), Ctrl+Y yana sake yi. Kowane gyara, har da aunawa, ana iya warwarewa.
tutorial.The History tab, next to Properties and: Shafin Tarihi, kusa da Kaddarori da Layuka, yana jera kowane aiki tun lokacin da aka buɗe fayil, irin na Photoshop. Danna mataki don komawa baya (ko gaba) gare shi; matakan gaba suna zama launin toka kuma ana iya sake yin su har sai sabon gyara ya watsar da su. Ctrl+Z da Ctrl+Y suna motsa mataki ɗaya a lokaci ɗaya.
tutorial.Whatever is selected is edited here: nam: Duk abin da aka zaɓa ana gyara shi a nan: suna, layer, bututu ("Ta atomatik" yana bar shirin ya auna shi), emitter, matsi, tazara, bawul, tushe, famfo… Bayan ƙira, sashin Sakamako yana nuna gudanar ruwa, gudu da matsi na abu.
tutorial.Del deletes the selection (or the alias: Del yana goge zaɓi (ko gajeriyar E). Ctrl+Z yana dawo da shi.
tutorial.Select something and press Del: Zaɓi wani abu ka danna Del
tutorial.Ctrl+D duplicates the selection beside i: Ctrl+D yana ninka zaɓi kusa da kansa. Ctrl+C / Ctrl+X / Ctrl+V suna kwafa, yanke da manna, har ma tsakanin shafukan ayyuka. Gyara → Jeri yana maimaita zaɓi a layuka da ginshiƙai.
tutorial.The Layers tab groups the objects (zone: Shafin Layuka yana haɗa abubuwa a rukuni (bututun yanki, babban bututu, emitters, radius na jiƙa, layukan tsayi, wurare, lakabi…): kowane layer yana da launi, bayyana da makulli, kuma yana nuna adadin abubuwan da ke cikinsa.
tutorial.The eye of each layer hides its objects;: Idon kowane layer yana ɓoye abubuwansa; makullin yana hana gyara. Yana da amfani don tsaftace allo kafin bugawa.
tutorial.Hide the Wetted radii layer: Ɓoye layer na Radius na jiƙa
tutorial.Snap locks the cursor onto nodes, endpoi: Kamawa yana kulle siginan linzami a kan mahaɗai, ƙarshen layi, tsakiya da kan bututu: haka emitters da bawuloli ke haɗuwa da bututu. Grid (F9) yana kama kan ninkin grid; F7 yana nuna grid.
tutorial.Press F3 (or click Snap in the status ba: Danna F3 (ko danna Kamawa a mashaya matsayi) don canzawa
tutorial.Ortho locks every segment to horizontal: Ortho yana kulle kowane sashi a kwance ko tsaye, kamar a AutoCAD. Bar shi a kunne don zana bututu masu daidaito.
tutorial.Line, polyline, rectangle, circle, arc,: Layi, polyline, murabba'i, da'ira, baka, spline, zane-zane, rubutu da ma'auni suna zana bayan ƙirar (iyakoki, hanyoyi, gine-gine). Zaɓe su a cikin palette, menu na Zana ko ta rubuta gajeriya.
tutorial.Pick Line (L) and click two points: Zaɓi Layi (L) ka danna wurare biyu
tutorial.As in Photoshop: hold Shift while drawin: Kamar a Photoshop: riƙe Shift yayin zana kuma sashin yana kullewa a 0°, 45° ko 90° daga wurin da ya gabata. Mashaya matsayi tana nuna [45°].
tutorial.With Line active, click a point and, hol: Da Layi yana aiki, danna wuri kuma, riƙe da Shift, danna na biyu
tutorial.Click the vertices; Enter or double-clic: Danna kusurwoyi; Enter ko danna sau biyu yana ƙarewa, Backspace yana cire wuri na ƙarshe, Esc yana sokewa.
tutorial.Type PL, click three points and press En: Rubuta PL, danna wurare uku ka danna Enter
tutorial.Circle (C): centre and a point on the ra: Da'ira (C): tsakiya da wuri a kan radius. Murabba'i (REC): kusurwoyi biyu masu fuskantar juna.
tutorial.Type C and click the centre and the radi: Rubuta C ka danna tsakiya da radius
tutorial.Text (T): click the point and type; heig: Rubutu (T): danna wuri ka rubuta; tsayi da juyawa suna cikin kaddarori. Lakabin gudanar ruwa da matsi ana samar da su ta atomatik bayan ƙira.
tutorial.Type T, click the drawing and write a te: Rubuta T, danna zane ka rubuta rubutu
tutorial.Dimension (D): two points and the dimens: Ma'auni (D): wurare biyu da wurin layin ma'auni; akwai ma'aunin kusurwa (DAN) da na radius (DRA). Auna (ME) yana nuna nisa da faɗi ba tare da ƙirƙirar komai ba.
tutorial.Type D and click two points and the dime: Rubuta D ka danna wurare biyu da wurin ma'auni
tutorial.With the drawing focused, type the alias: Da zanen yana da hankali, rubuta gajeriya kamar a AutoCAD (L, PL, C, REC, ZP, MP, SL, V, WS…) da Enter ko Space; bayan ɗan dakata yana gudana da kansa. Mashaya matsayi tana nuna umarni da abin da zai yi. Taimako → Gajerun hanyoyi yana jera su duka.
tutorial.The editing group of the palette (or RO,: Rukunin gyara na palette (ko RO, MI, SC, O, TR, EX, CUT) yana juyawa, madubi, ma'auni, gusarwa, datsewa, tsawaitawa da yanke bututun zaɓi. Saka bawul, mahaɗi, famfo ko na'ura a kan bututu yana raba shi a wurin.
tutorial.Contours and spot heights form the digit: Layukan tsayi da wuraren tsayi suna samar da samfurin ƙasa na dijital (triangulation): tsayin kowane bututu da emitter ana ƙididdige shi daga gare su kuma yana shiga lissafin matsi. Kowane layi yana haɗa wurare masu tsayi ɗaya: idan ka gama (Enter) taga tana tambayar tsayi kuma tana shirya layi na gaba ta ƙara tazara (misali 100, 101, 102 m). Za ka iya kuma shigo da DXF, wuraren CSV ko sauke tsayi daga intanet (Ƙira → Ƙasa).
tutorial.Type CT, click the contour points, Enter: Rubuta CT, danna wuraren layin tsayi, Enter ka tabbatar da tsayi
tutorial.A spot height (SP) fixes the elevation a: Wurin tsayi (SP) yana tsayar da tsayi a wuri ɗaya: rijiya, gidan famfo, kusurwoyin gona. Ana tambayar tsayi a kowane dannawa (kashe shi a kaddarorin kayan aiki don sake amfani da ƙima ɗaya). Ƙira → Ƙasa → Kallon 3D yana nuna samfurin da aka samu kuma Samar da layukan tsayi yana zana layukan samfurin.
tutorial.Type SP, click a point and give the elev: Rubuta SP, danna wuri ka ba da tsayi
tutorial.Elevation from the internet and model co: Tsayi daga intanet da layukan samfuri
tutorial.Design → Terrain gathers the relief tool: Ƙira → Ƙasa yana tattara kayan aikin ƙasa: Sauke tsayi daga intanet yana ƙirƙirar grid na wuraren tsayi daga samfurin tsayin ƙasa na jama'a (yana buƙatar matsayin wuri a Fayil → Matsayin wuri); Samar da layukan tsayi yana zana layuka daga samfuri; Ƙididdiga tana zaɓar triangulation (DTM) ko nisa ta juye; Share bayanin tsayi yana cire hanyar shunayya.
tutorial.The Area tool (AR) defines polygons with: Kayan aikin Wuri (AR) yana ƙayyade polygons da zurfin ruwa na gaske da inganci: rahoton Buƙatun ruwa yana lissafa girma da lokacin ban ruwa ga kowane wuri daga emitters da ke cikinsa.
tutorial.Type AR, click the corners of an area an: Rubuta AR, danna kusurwoyin wuri da Enter
tutorial.Every network starts at a supply (well,: Kowace hanyar sadarwa tana farawa a tushe (rijiya, tanki, ruwan gari). Shigar da matsi da gudanar ruwa da ke akwai, ko bar "Lissafa matsi" don shirin ya faɗi abin da tushen dole ya bayar.
tutorial.Type WS and click where the supply is: Rubuta WS ka danna inda tushen yake
tutorial.Mainline pipe (MP): draw from the supply: Babban bututu (MP): zana daga tushe zuwa inda bawuloli za su kasance. Abubuwan babban bututu suna haɗuwa da abubuwan babban bututu kawai; diamita na iya zama tsayayye ko "Ta atomatik".
tutorial.Type MP and draw a pipe from the new sup: Rubuta MP ka zana bututu daga sabon tushe
tutorial.Pump (PU) and devices (F: filter, meter,: Famfo (PU) da na'urori (F: tace, mita, PRV, bawul na ƙofa, bawul na iska) ana saka su a kan babban bututu, wanda ake raba a wurin. Lanƙwasar famfo tana zuwa daga kasida; Babban bututu → Zaɓi famfo yana jera famfo don wurin aiki.
tutorial.Type PU and click on the mainline pipe: Rubuta PU ka danna kan babban bututu
tutorial.The valve (V) separates each zone from t: Bawul (V) yana raba kowane yanki daga babban bututu: haɗa shi a ƙarshen babban bututu. Manifold, laterals da emitters suna rataye a gefen yanki.
tutorial.Type V and click at the end of the mainl: Rubuta V ka danna ƙarshen babban bututu
tutorial.Zone pipe (ZP): downstream of the valve,: Bututun yanki (ZP): bayan bawul, zana manifold da ke ciyar da laterals.
tutorial.Type ZP and draw a pipe from the valve: Rubuta ZP ka zana bututu daga bawul
tutorial.Sprayline (SL) creates a pipe with equal: Layin fesa ruwa (SL) yana ƙirƙirar bututu mai emitters masu tazara ɗaya; Tef (DT) yana ƙirƙirar tef ɗin ɗigo da bayanan kasida. Emitter, bakin fesawa, matsin da aka ƙayyade da tazara suna cikin kaddarori; matsin da aka ƙayyade da haƙuri suna ƙayyade tagar matsin da aka yarda na yanki.
tutorial.Type SL and draw a lateral from the subm: Rubuta SL ka zana lateral daga manifold
tutorial.Outlet (EM) places a sprinkler or emitte: Emitter (EM) yana sanya mai fesa ruwa ko emitter a kan bututun yanki; radius na jiƙa yana bayyana a layer na Radius na jiƙa. Kasida tana da ƙananan masu fesa ruwa, masu fesa ruwa na bugu, bindigogi da masu ɗigo.
tutorial.Type EM and click on the submain: Rubuta EM ka danna kan manifold
tutorial.Block (B): click the field corners, Ente: Rukuni (B): danna kusurwoyin gona, Enter, sannan zaɓi nau'i (ƙaramin fesa ruwa ko ɗigo), emitter, tazara, fuskantarwa, wurin manifold da bawul: shirin yana samar da laterals, manifold, guntu da bawul. Hanya mafi sauri ta gina yanki.
tutorial.Type B, click four corners, Enter and co: Rubuta B, danna kusurwoyi huɗu, Enter ka tabbatar da tattaunawa
tutorial.Grid (AH): fills a polygon with sprinkle: Grid (AH): yana cika polygon da masu fesa ruwa a tsarin murabba'i ko triangular daga tazara ko radius na jiƙa, don a haɗa su da bututun yanki daga baya.
tutorial.Type AH, click the corners of an area, E: Rubuta AH, danna kusurwoyin wuri, Enter ka tabbatar
tutorial.Design → Parameters: head-loss formula (: Ƙira → Sigogi: dabarar asarar matsi (Hazen-Williams ko Darcy-Weisbach), zafi, gudu mafi girma, ƙananan asara, riba, tsawon lokaci, kuɗin makamashi da awanni/shekara don daidaita kuɗin bututu da kuɗin famfo. Ƙira → Kasida: bututu, emitters, tef, bawuloli da famfo masu farashi; gyara ko kashe abubuwa.
tutorial.Design → System flows defines which valv: Ƙira → Zangunan aiki yana ƙayyade waɗanne bawuloli ke buɗewa tare da tsawon lokaci. Kowane zango yanayin nauyi ne ga babban bututu; ana auna tushe ga mafi muni. "Duka tare" da "Ɗaya bayan ɗaya" suna cika tebur.
tutorial.Design → Design check (CHK) sweeps the d: Ƙira → Duba ƙira (CHK) yana bincika zane don matsaloli: abubuwan da ba a haɗa ba (ja a zane), bututun da ke ƙetare juna ba tare da mahaɗi ba, ƙarshen matattu, yankuna ba tare da emitters ba, kwafi, samfuran kasida da suka ɓace da hanyoyin sadarwa masu zagaye. Danna abu a jerin don gano shi ka gyara shi ta motsa shi da kamawa a kan bututu.
tutorial.Run the check (Design menu or CHK): Gudanar da duba (menu na Ƙira ko CHK)
tutorial.▶ or F5 runs the full cycle: sizes each: ▶ ko F5 yana gudanar da cikakken zagaye: yana auna bututun atomatik na kowane yanki bisa tagar matsi da la'akari da tattalin arziki, yana saita matsin bawuloli, yana lissafa babban bututu ga kowane zango, abin da tushe dole ya bayar, wankewa, bugun ruwa da jerin kayan aiki. Lissafi yana gudana a baya da panel na ci gaba.
tutorial.After the design, pipes are coloured by: Bayan ƙira, bututu suna da launi bisa gudu (shuɗi → kore → lemu → ja sama da iyaka), bawuloli da tushe suna nuna gudanar ruwa da matsi, kuma bututu suna nuna gudanar ruwa/gudu idan an ƙara girma. A Kallo, canza zuwa launi bisa matsi (emitters da ke wajen taga a ja/shunayya) ko nuna diamita.
tutorial.In View, choose Colour by pressure: A Kallo, zaɓi Launi bisa matsi
tutorial.The bottom panel (F2) has tabs: Zone sum: Panel na ƙasa (F2) yana da shafuka: Taƙaitaccen yanki (gudanar ruwa, matsi, tagar da aka yarda da ta gaske, CU/DU/EU), Bututu, Emitters, Babban bututu/wurin aiki, Jerin kayan aiki da kuɗi, Buƙatun ruwa, Layin matsin ruwa, Saƙonni, Bayanin tsayi, Wankewa, Bugun ruwa, Ilimin noma da Jadawali. Ja gefen don canza girma.
tutorial.Every segment with the chosen diameter,: Kowane sashi da diamitar da aka zaɓa, gudanar ruwa, gudu, asarar matsi da matsin sama/ƙasa. Danna layi don gano bututu a zane.
tutorial.Design warnings: velocity above the limi: Gargaɗin ƙira: gudu sama da iyaka, matsi wajen taga, abubuwan da ba a haɗa ba, gibin tushe. Danna saƙo don zaɓa da kuma tsara abu.
tutorial.In the Hydraulic grade line tab, select: A shafin Layin matsin ruwa, zaɓi bututu, lateral ko bawul: jadawali yana nuna ƙasa, layin makamashi da yankin matsin da aka yarda tare da hanya. Ya dace don ganin inda matsi ke faɗuwa ƙasa da mafi ƙanƙanta a ƙasa mai tuddai.
tutorial.Open the Hydraulic grade line tab and se: Buɗe shafin Layin matsin ruwa ka zaɓi lateral
tutorial.Zone → Allowable submain position (FE) p: Yanki → Wurin manifold da aka yarda (FE) yana fenti kore sashin kowane lateral da aka zaɓa inda manifold zai iya zama yayin cika tagar matsi.
tutorial.Profile (PR): click the points of a path: Bayanin tsayi (PR): danna wuraren hanya da Enter; shafin Bayanin tsayi yana nuna ƙasa tare da ita (layin ruwan ƙasa), wuri mafi ƙasa (shuɗi) da mafi tsayi (lemu). Zaɓar bututun da aka ƙirƙira yana kuma nuna bututu (shuɗi, da zurfinsa) da layin matsin ruwa (kore): tazarar tsaye tsakaninsu ita ce matsi. Kai siginan linzami kan jadawali don karanta tasha, tsayi da matsi. Layin shunayya a zane shine hanya: Share (a shafin) ko Esc yana cire shi.
tutorial.Type PR, click two points and press Ente: Rubuta PR, danna wurare biyu ka danna Enter
tutorial.Centre pivot and linear move: Pivot na tsakiya da injin layi
tutorial.Mainline → Pivot (PV): click the pivot p: Babban bututu → Pivot (PV): danna wurin pivot a kan babban bututu sannan ƙarshen tsawon. Pivot ya zama wurin buƙata: gudanar ruwa daga faɗi, zurfi da awanni ga kowane juyi; matsin shiga daga gogayyar tsawo (ƙimar 0.543), tsayin bututu, hawan ƙasa mafi muni kewaye da da'ira da matsin ƙarshe. Kaddarori suna saita tsawo, bututu, bindigar ƙarshe da sashe; shafin Pivots yana jera hasumiyoyi, ƙimar shafawa da gibi.
tutorial.Type PV, click the pivot point and the e: Rubuta PV, danna wurin pivot da ƙarshen tsawon
tutorial.Align an image or drawing by 2 points: Daidaita hoto ko zane da wurare 2
tutorial.Imported a satellite photo or a DXF out: Ka shigo da hoton tauraron ɗan adam ko DXF ba tare da ma'auni ba? Zaɓe shi ka yi amfani da Fayil → Daidaita da wurare 2 (AL): danna wuri sananne a hoto, inda dole ya tafi, wuri na biyu da manufarsa. Ana motsa, juya da auna zaɓi a lokaci ɗaya (ko motsa da juyawa kawai da "riƙe ma'auni").
tutorial.Tools → Lateral calculator: maximum leng: Kayan aiki → Kalkuleta na lateral: tsawo mafi girma, asara da daidaito na tef ko lateral a gangara. Famfo da lanƙwasar tsarin: wurin aiki, ƙarfi da makamashin shekara. Bugun ruwa: ƙarin matsi na Joukowsky da ajin bututu. Ma'auni: metric ko na Amurka.
tutorial.Ctrl+S downloads the project as open JSO: Ctrl+S yana sauke aikin a matsayin JSON buɗaɗɗe (.oci.json), tare da sakamako; Ctrl+O yana buɗe shi. Aikin kuma ana ajiye shi ta atomatik a mai binciken gizo: sake buɗe shafin yana ba da damar dawo da shi, kuma kowane Ajiye yana ajiye siga (Fayil → Tarihin sigogi).
tutorial.Import (Ctrl+I) accepts DXF, DWG (AutoCA: Shigo (Ctrl+I) yana karɓar DXF, DWG (AutoCAD 2000–2018), KML/KMZ, SHP, wuraren CSV/XYZ da hotuna (JPG/PNG/GeoTIFF, da taswirar tushe ta tauraron ɗan adam a ƙarƙashin Kallo). Fitar da zane yana rubuta DXF, DWG, PDF (takardar bugawa da akwatin take, bayani da ma'auni; Ctrl+P), SVG, KML/KMZ da GeoJSON. Fitar da rahoto yana rubuta CSV, TXT, XLSX ko PDF.
tutorial.Several projects open at once: Ctrl+Alt+: Ayyuka da yawa a buɗe a lokaci ɗaya: Ctrl+Alt+N yana buɗe shafi, Ctrl+Alt+W yana rufe shi, Ctrl+Alt+← → yana canzawa. Kwafa da manna suna aiki tsakanin shafuka, kuma Fayil → Bayanan aiki yana ajiye abokin ciniki, wuri da mai ƙira.
tutorial.Help → Keyboard shortcuts lists every co: Taimako → Gajerun hanyoyin allon maɓalli yana jera kowane umarni da maɓalli; Taimako → Koyarwa mai mu'amala yana sake buɗe wannan koyarwa (URL ?tutorial=N yana buɗewa a mataki). Kallo yana canza harshe da ma'auni. A waya ko tablet allon yana canzawa: menu ☰ a sama, mashayar kayan aiki bisa rukuni a ƙasa, maɓallan An gama/Soke maimakon Enter/Esc, kaddarori da rahotanni a zanen gadon da ke zamewa; matse don ƙara girma, yatsu biyu don motsawa. Ƙira mai daɗi!
tutorial.View → Mark min/max pressure per zone hi: Kallo → Yi alama matsi ƙarami/babba ga kowane yanki yana fitowa fili, a kowane yanki, emitter mai mafi ƙarancin matsi da mai mafi girman matsi: su ne ke ƙayyade ainihin bambancin yankin idan aka kwatanta da tagar da aka yarda a taƙaitawa. Kallo yana kuma kunna ko kashe Lakabi, Radius na jiƙa da Maƙallan gyara.
tutorial.In the System flows window, the Controll: A cikin tagar Zangon aiki, sashen Shirin mai sarrafawa yana gina jadawali: adadin kwanaki, lokacin farawar rana, “yi amfani da lokutan farawa na zanguna kansu”, kuma “Aiwatar da tsawon lokacin da aka lissafa” yana cika kowane zango da awoyin ban ruwa daga filayen da ake ban ruwa (bayan ƙira). Shafin Jadawali yana lissafa kowane taron da kwanan wata, zango, yankuna, farawa, ƙarshe da tsawon lokaci; Fayil → Fitar da rahoto → Fitar da shiri yana rubuta CSV ga mai sarrafawa.
tutorial.In View, choose Mark min/max pressure pe: A Kallo, zaɓi Yi alama matsi ƙarami/babba ga kowane yanki
tutorial.Ctrl+A (or the alias ALL) selects everyt: Ctrl+A (ko gajeren suna ALL) yana zaɓar duk abin da ake gani kuma ba a kulle ba. Idan an zaɓi abubuwa da yawa, fanel ɗin kaddarori yana gyara su duka a lokaci ɗaya: filayen da ke da ƙimomi daban-daban suna nuna “(ƙimomi daban-daban)”, kuma duk abin da ka rubuta yana shafar su duka. Yana da amfani wajen canza emitter na laterals da yawa ko layer na gungun layuka.
tutorial.Click the Mainline/duty tab: Danna shafin Babban bututu / wurin aiki
tutorial.On sloping ground laterals follow the co: A ƙasa mai gangara laterals suna bin layukan tsayi. Zaɓi layi, polyline, spline ko layin tsayi kafin ka rubuta B: akwatin toshe yana bayar da “Laterals suna bin layin da aka zaɓa” kuma yana ƙirƙirar laterals a matsayin kwafin da aka matsar na wannan layin, a tazarar da aka zaɓa, a cikin polygon. Misalin “Kofi a layukan tsayi” yana amfani da wannan fasalin.
tutorial.Type SY and click where to insert the sy: Rubuta SY sannan ka danna inda za a saka alamar
tutorial.File → Examples opens 15 projects ready: Fayil → Misalai yana buɗe ayyuka 15 da suka shirya don ƙira: gonar 'ya'yan itace, lambu, filin ƙwallon ƙafa, amfanin gona na layi da ɗiga, pivot na tsakiya da na sashe, na'ura mai motsi a layi, gidan shuka, gandun shuka, kofi a layukan tsayi, ayaba, rake da ɗiga a ƙarƙashin ƙasa, ɗiga ta nauyi, makiyaya da ramin golf. Taimako → Barka da zuwa da hoton misalai yana nuna hoton ɗaya da bayanai. Fayil → Ayyukan kwanan nan yana sake buɗe abin da aka ajiye a wannan burauzar, kuma Taimako → Game da yana nuna sigar shirin.
tutorial.Examples, recent projects and welcome: Misalai, ayyukan kwanan nan da barka da zuwa
tutorial.Besides the default layers, create your: Baya ga layers na asali, ƙirƙiri naka da “Sabon layer” a ƙasan shafin Layers: ba shi suna da launi. Danna sau biyu yana canza suna, ɗigon yana nuna layer na yanzu (inda sababbin layuka, rubutu da alamomi ke shiga), murabba'in launi yana canza launi, kuma Goge yana mayar da abubuwansa zuwa DRAWING. Layers suna zama layers na DXF/DWG da bayanin takardar PDF.
tutorial.Also in Design → Parameters: sizing meth: Har ila yau a Ƙira → Sigogi: hanyar auna girma (shirye-shiryen layi, wanda ke auna kuɗin bututu, makamashi da yanayin ƙasa, ko greedy ta gudu → tagar matsi → tattalin arziki); iyakar adadin girma ga kowane lateral, submain da babban bututu (telescoping); emitters ga kowace shuka (EU) da iyakar bambancin matsi na yanki; gudun wankewa da mafi ƙarancin matsi a ƙarshen tef; duba bugun ruwa da lokacin rufe bawul da ajin bututu; zaɓin haɗi ta atomatik da tsawon sandar bututu (couplers); ƙara yawan DEM da haƙurin haɗi.
tutorial.Menus at the top, tool palette on the le: Menus a sama, faifan kayan aiki a hagu, zanen CAD a tsakiya, kaddarori da layers a dama, mashayar matsayi a ƙasa. An ɗora gonar 'ya'yan itace ta misali mai toshe biyu. Kowane mataki na wannan koyarwar yana neman aiki kuma yana gane lokacin da ka yi shi; “Nuna mini” yana yi maka.
tutorial.The Bill of materials tab groups pipes (: Shafin Jerin kayan aiki yana haɗa bututu (bisa girma da aji), tef, emitters, bawuloli, na'urori, famfuna kuma, idan zaɓi ta atomatik yana kunne, haɗi: couplers ga kowace sanda, gwiwoyi, tees, masu rage girma, murfin ƙarshe, mafitar lateral da risers. Yana nuna yawa, kuɗin kowane ɗaya daga kasida, jimillar kowane rukuni da kuɗin shekara (jarin da aka raba shekara + makamashi). Ana fitar da shi a CSV, TXT, XLSX ko PDF ta Fayil → Fitar da rahoto, kuma takardar PDF na iya ɗaukar jerin.
tutorial.In the pivot properties choose the sprin: A kaddarorin pivot zaɓi mai fesa ruwa da mai daidaita matsi daga kasida, tazarar masu fesa ruwa da kuɗin kowane hasumiya. Shafin Pivots yana taƙaita kowace na'ura (hasumiyoyi, fili, matsin da ake buƙata da wanda ke akwai, zurfi da awoyi a kowane zagaye, mafi girman ƙimar ban ruwa); shafin Tsawon pivot yana bayyana kowane tsawo: radius na farko da na ƙarshe, adadin masu fesa ruwa, kwarara ga kowane mai fesa ruwa, matsi a tsawon da bakin da aka ba da shawara. Hasumiyoyi, masu fesa ruwa da bindigar ƙarshe suna shiga jerin kayan aiki.
tutorial.The Design menu splits the cycle: Size z: Menu na Ƙira yana raba zagayen: Auna yankuna yana lissafa laterals da submains kawai; Auna babban bututu babban bututu da tushen ruwa kawai; Bincika (girman da ke akwai) ba ya canza kowane diamita, yana lissafa kwarara da matsi da bututun kamar yadda aka zana, ya dace don duba shigarwar da ke akwai ko zaɓinka; Share sakamako yana cire sakamako da lakabi. Duk wani gyara a hanyar sadarwa yana soke sakamakon har sai lissafi na gaba.
tutorial.Sizing in parts and analysing: Auna girma a sassa da bincike
tutorial.Marking minimum and maximum pressure: Yin alama matsi ƙarami da babba
tutorial.Junction (J): a node that joins pipes. T: Mahaɗi (J): wuri ne da ke haɗa bututu. Bututu biyu da suka haye juna ba tare da mahaɗi ba ba a haɗa su ba (Duba ƙira yana gargaɗi): saka mahaɗi a wurin hayewa, sai a raba bututun a haɗa su a nan. Yana kuma amfani wajen reshe bututu a tsakiya ko tabbatar da tsayin wuri. Menu na Babban bututu yana da sigar babban bututu.
tutorial.With the project georeferenced (File → G: Idan aikin yana da matsayin wuri (Fayil → Matsayin wuri, ta latitude/longitude ko UTM), Kallo → Taswirar tushe yana sa taswira a ƙarƙashin zane: OpenStreetMap, OpenTopoMap, CARTO da Esri (tituna, yanayin ƙasa, tauraron ɗan adam) ba tare da maɓalli ba; Google Maps (taswirar hanya, tauraron ɗan adam, gauraye, yanayin ƙasa) da maɓallin Map Tiles API naka; ko URL na XYZ na musamman daga sabar ka. Za a iya sanya hoton da aka shigo da shi ta Fayil → Saita matsayin wurin hoton da aka zaɓa (kusurwa, girma da juyawa) ko ta Daidaita da wurare 2; GeoTIFF da fayilolin world suna sauka a wurin da ya dace da kansu.
tutorial.Pivot spans and sprinklers: Tsawon pivot da masu fesa ruwa
tutorial.Base maps and georeferenced images: Taswirorin tushe da hotuna masu matsayin wuri
tutorial.In Design, choose Analyse (existing size: A Ƙira, zaɓi Bincika (girman da ke akwai)
tutorial.Type J and click on a zone pipe: Rubuta J sannan ka danna kan bututun yanki
tutorial.Mainline/duty: for each system flow, the: Babban bututu / wurin aiki: ga kowane zangon aiki, kwarara da matsin da ake buƙata a tushen ruwa, matsin da ke akwai, tsayin famfo, makamashi a shekara da matsayi (ok ko gazawa). Emitters: kowane emitter da kwararar da matsin da aka lissafa. Buƙatun ruwa: ga kowane fili, zurfin gaba ɗaya, yawa da awoyi a rana. Wankewa: gudu a ƙarshen kowane tef/lateral idan aka kwatanta da gudun da ake so. Bugun ruwa: gudun igiyar ruwa, ƙarin matsi da jimillar matsi na kowane bututu idan aka kwatanta da ajinsa (PN).
tutorial.Select an irrigated area: besides net de: Zaɓi fili da ake ban ruwa: baya ga zurfin tsantsa da inganci, sashen Ma'aunin ruwa na kaddarori yana ɗaukar amfanin gona (Kc da aka shirya daga FAO-56), ETo, ruwan da ke cikin ƙasa, zurfin saiwa, raguwar da aka yarda (MAD), kason da aka jiƙa da tazarar shuke-shuke da layuka. Shafin Ilimin noma yana lissafa ETc, zurfin tsantsa da na gaba ɗaya ga kowane ban ruwa, tazarar tsakanin ban ruwa da awoyi ga kowane ban ruwa da emitters da ke cikin filin, tare da CU na haɗuwa.
tutorial.In Design → Catalog, \"Manufacturer cata: A Ƙira → Kasida, “Kasidun masana'antu…” yana lissafa fakitin kayayyaki masu wakilci (bututu, emitters, tef, bawuloli, famfuna): waɗanda ke tare da manhajar da waɗanda aka ɗora yanzu. Ƙara fakiti a aikin, shigo da fayil .oci.cat ko ɗora shi daga URL (fakiti ko index.json). Kasidar tana kuma shigo da JSON, CSV ko Excel, tana fitar da Excel/CSV/JSON, kuma tana fitar da kasidarka a matsayin fakiti don rabawa. “Yi amfani a matsayin tsoho ga sabbin ayyuka” da “Mayar da tsoho” suna sarrafa kasidar farko.
tutorial.Symbol (SY): inserts a vector symbol in: Alama (SY): tana saka alamar vector a cikin zane: kibiyar arewa, itace, gini, tanki, rijiya, akwatin bawul, ɗakin famfo, ƙofa ko tashar tace ruwa; iri, girma da juyawa suna cikin kaddarori. Layin nuni (LE): danna kan kibiya da kusurwoyi, Enter yana buɗe rubutun bayani. Dukansu suna shiga DXF/DWG da takardar PDF.
